known_failure: the taper-to-fit round's area is off the reference (the fillet room law)
method: plate (top 20 -> 2 wide over x 0..40, 15 high) with its top front edge filleted at 3, fit: taper. The radius is the taper law: a clamped cubic B-spline in u = x/40 on 8 equal spans, control radii min(3, 0.9 room) at the Greville abscissae, room = min(20 - 18u, 15) tan 45 deg (top face width, front face height): 3.0000, 3.0000, 3.0000, 3.0000, 3.0000, 3.0000, 3.0000, 3.0000, 3.0000, 2.4750, 1.8000. The round is the union of the balls rolled along the edge, ball s touching both faces at r(s), the law continued past the edge's ends along its end slopes: each section loses the corner points no ball reaches, up to rho(x, t), the nearest entry into a ball along the ray from the edge at the angle t. V, moments and areas integrated by Gauss-Legendre panels in x and t, per knot span
